text: And the people{H5971} were as murmurers,{H596} [speaking] evil in the ears{H7451} of Jehovah:{H3068} and when Jehovah{H3068} heard{H8085} it, his anger{H639} was kindled;{H2734} and the fire{H784} of Jehovah{H3068} burnt{H1197} among them, and devoured{H398} in the uttermost part{H7097} of the camp.{H4264}

And Moses{H4872} said{H559} unto Jehovah,{H3068} Wherefore hast thou dealt ill{H7489} with thy servant?{H5650} and wherefore have I not found{H4672} favor{H2580} in thy sight,{H5869} that thou layest{H7760} the burden{H4853} of all this people{H5971} upon me?

Shall flocks{H6629} and herds{H1241} be slain{H7819} for them, to suffice{H4672} them? or shall all the fish{H1709} of the sea{H3220} be gathered together{H622} for them, to suffice{H4672} them?
